title: Chapter 1040
paragraphs: Chapter 1040
Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (7)

Vahn sat in meditation once again for a while. Chiron, seemingly a bit tired, also sat down beside her to meditate, and so did the Battle Kings and Ozdok, though as a demonic creature, meditation didn't really have an effect on him.
"Take this."

Vahn, standing up, grabbed the fragment floating in the air with one hand. She then squeezed it as if crushing an apple, but it didn't completely destroy it. The crushed fragment became like a broken machine, no longer functional.
Vahn was aware that the fragment wasn't entirely destroyed and with just a slight trigger, it could turn into something as dangerous as it had been during the recent battle.

"Chiron, it would be best for you to take this and deal with it. It's too dangerous to try and utilize for research. Just discard it somewhere where no one, including the Sun God Religion, can find it."
"Understood. I'm not sure if the Sun God Religion would continue to exist if they met you today."
"By the way, did you leave the other members of the expedition behind?"
"Passing through the dimensional gate's spirit energy multiple times is dangerous."

Chiron didn't get affected due to his sheer strength, and Ozdok, being a demonic creature, was immune to the dimensional gate's influence. The Plutonians was naturally immune, so they could use the dimensional gate created by Nirgand's spirit energy and the power of the Sun God without any adverse effects.
"Indeed, that makes sense."

The Battle Kings and Ozdok followed the two. The Battle Kings were amazed by how much Jet and Ozdok resembled each other, as Luna had said, and Ozdok found it hard to comprehend the strength of the Battle Kings, possibly even stronger than the expedition members.
"How does it look outside?"

"It's quite chaotic. In some ways, more than when your ancestor fought a thousand years ago. That's why I think the number of Genesis has increased. Even your eldest daughter reached the realm the day I was liberated."
"Luna ascended to Genesis more easily compared to Jin."
"In some ways, it might have been harder for her. She was too strong from birth, perhaps struggling more with her path than Jin."
"That's also true. It was Jin who freed you and the Plutonians, right?"
"That's correct."
"Tell me about what happened."

Vahn summarized everything that had happened since Luna left the expedition, including the war with the Vamel Alliance and the Red Plutonian, leading to the liberation of the Plutonians, and shared it with Chiron.
Some of it Chiron knew through Jin and Luna's inner worlds, and some he had guessed from the energy reaching the domain of the Black Sea Five Kings.
But he found the details he didn't know quite interesting, especially hearing about the achievements of his grown children.
"…They're all doing well."
"Despite a constant smile on your face and your eyes shining, your remarks are somewhat brief."
"You had quite the face when explaining Jin's achievements."
"Of course, he's my brother."
"I too am his father…"
Chiron suddenly remembered the years he had been consumed by demonic nature.

His children, especially Jin, had silently endured many burdens that Chiron should have carried himself. Rosa's death was the greatest stain on his life, a stain of failing to care for his family while bearing his destiny.

Vahn also had her own pains. The decision of 'War with the Gods,' the siblings who died then, and the current Plutonians members, who barely survived and were sealed away from the world for half a millennium.

Perhaps because only Vahn and Chiron were at the same level, during the moment of silence, they reflected on each other's experiences. It seemed they could understand each other without any explanation.
"Talaris, and Ron. It's been a while since I've had a conversation like this with someone besides them."
"For me, it's the first time since your founding ancestor."
"Temar Runcandel, what kind of person was he?"

"In terms of strength, he definitely wasn’t as powerful as you. But even I couldn't guarantee a victory against him. Despite a clear difference in our realms, he could defeat anyone. However, he never actually did so, as he eventually broke against the Zipfel."
"What do you think was the reason?"

"I was already sealed during that era, so I don’t know the exact details of the War of the Sword Demons. I only heard about the general flow. But based on the Temar I knew, I’d say... he wasn’t very smart."
"You dare insult my ancestor."
"When I first saw Jin, he reminded me and my brothers of Temar reincarnated. He seemed to share many similarities. But now that I think about it, Temar was more like you."
"Didn’t you just say the founding ancestor wasn’t very smart?"
"Do you consider yourself intelligent?"
"That's the first time I've been asked that."

"Being intelligent means being rational. But your life has been far from rational. At some point, you realized your fate and dedicated your entire life to the Black Sea. That’s not rationality but rather an act close to instinct."
Chiron quietly waited for Vahn's next words. Ozdok decided not to be surprised by Vahn's casual attitude towards Chiron anymore.
"Even after overcoming demonic nature, it's not much different. You're still faithful to your destiny, and it’s not a matter of rationality or will."
Vahn's interpretation left Chiron in thought. Ozdok, meanwhile, made a decision to stop being surprised by Vahn's casual approach to Chiron.
Although they had just met today, Vahn understood Chiron's life better than anyone else.
She was the same as him, living a life faithful only to destiny, beyond the control of reason or will. The result of this was the war with the gods.
"You, like those of the Sun God Religion or the Red Plutonian claim, are living a life predetermined from birth. So am I... and so was Temar. But Jin, as I see it, is different."
Chiron fell into thought for a moment.
"Doubt."
"Yes, doubt. That's what sets Jin apart from us. Neither I, you, nor Temar ever doubted our fate and choices."
Vahn had a destiny to conquer the world, Temar to fight against the Zipfel, and Chiron to conquer the Black Sea. And they never doubted as they moved forward.
In Jin's case, however, there were countless moments when he doubted himself. As a returner, every choice he made changed the world.
For better or worse, all those events became Jin's responsibility.
"As a result, both Temar and I failed. But thanks to Jin, the savior, I was able to embark on a new destiny, and Temar's will was inherited. I hope you don't rely on Jin like Temar and I did."
"I plan not to."
"Haha, truly, if you fulfill your destiny alone, then you can say you've beaten me again. To defeat me twice, what an honor that would be."
"If I'm still in peak condition by then, I'll have to defeat you."
"True to the father of Jin."
They had already passed through two dimensional gates. If they retraced Chiron's path, one more gate would lead to the Sun God Religion's gate.
"Chiron, is there any additional information to convey to the world about the Black Sea?"
"Not yet. If there was, I would have sent some expedition members back as before."
Vahn's gaze fell on the Barisada at Chiron's waist.
"I wonder what the space that demands that sword as a key really is."
"It's definitely related to Lord Solderet. It was thanks to the records left by Lord Solderet that we knew about it."

"Solderet, a god hard to fathom. Our Plutonians avoided destruction thanks to him. He planned many things for Jin long ago. A thousand years ago, he had already designated Jin as the final contractor. If that key reveals secrets about him, let me know."
"Understood."
They continued to share stories, like old friends meeting after a long time. Behind them, the Battle Kings and Ozdok, now close, were giggling.
[This Jet guy really resembles me? I'm looking forward to it. When I return, I’ll see who is the best subordinate in the industry.]
"What a peculiar competition."
"Even though you once cornered Jin and Mary together, you have no such intentions now, Ozdok?"

[Knowing what you're good at is important. In that sense, both Jet and I didn't know ourselves well but were lucky to meet our lords. You know, Plutonians, the world is vast and full of strong beings. Yet, a loyal inner demon like me, who serves the master well, is quite rare.]
"Stay strong, Ozdok!"
[Understood, Baba!]
They crossed the last dimensional gate.
Then, at the entrance of the Five Kings' domain, another dimensional gate of the Sun God Religion appeared nearby.
This gate was imbued with a stronger spirit energy than the ones they just used. It seemed the lingering spirit energy of Nirgand, like a grudge, prevented the gate from closing.
Of course, they couldn't be sure if crossing this gate would lead directly to the Sun God Religion's hideout. A trap could be waiting.
However, Vahn and the Plutonians didn't care. They thought whatever appeared could just be destroyed. With their strength, they could even grab the tail of the Sun God Religion right after Nirgand.
"It was nice meeting you, Chiron Runcandel."
"Me as well, Battle God."
They shook hands and smiled.
"Once all the battles are over, let's have a grand drink. Not from a scuffed pauldron, but a proper cup."
"Agreed. But the pauldron I used as a cup was actually quite clean. You cleverly managed not to polish it further before using it."
Vahn hadn't polished the pauldron further to avoid appearing 'fussy' to Chiron. It would have felt like losing, despite the Plutonians being quite particular about hygiene.
"…I should've known. I'll convey your regards."
"Go ahead."
"Farewell! Ozdok."
[Go ahead, everyone. Stay bright and cheerful! After all, you're not living in a tough land like the Black Sea, haha.]
Soon, the Plutonians disappeared into the dimensional gate. Chiron watched their departure, then chuckled and moved on.
And the disciples of the Sun God Religion, suddenly faced with the Plutonians, were startled and stepped back.
"What, what is this!"
"Inform the High Priest, quickly!"
Vahn looked down at them and said
"Brothers. Close all the passages of this space, including the dimensional gate we just used."
